_doc.zh: 用来对照的已发表数据：在体压入的力–位移、体位改变的位移量级。只收本项目打开过原文的数值；找不到的如实写明。
_doc.en: Published data to compare against: in-vivo indentation force–displacement and the scale of posture-induced displacement. Only numbers whose text this project opened; what was not found is said so.

site.zh: 前臂，脂肪最厚处（该文的 P2）
site.en: forearm, the high-fat-thickness site (P2 of the paper)

indentation.where: section 2.5 (prescribed 5 mm minus 0.5 mm gap) and the note of Table 8

caveat.zh: 单个受试者；该点在前臂上的确切位置没有在打开的文字里给出，本项目取前臂掌侧中段。
caveat.en: One subject; the exact position of the site on the forearm is not given in the text opened, so the mid volar forearm is used here.

site.zh: 前臂，肌肉最厚处（该文的 P3）
site.en: forearm, the high-muscle-thickness site (P3 of the paper)

indentation.where: section 2.5 (prescribed 3.5 mm minus 0.3 mm gap) and the note of Table 9

site.zh: 手，皮肤为主的点（该文的 P1）
site.en: hand, the skin-dominant site (P1 of the paper)

indentation.where: section 2.5 and the note of Table 7

caveat.zh: 没有模拟：手部的软组织比笼子的单元还薄。
caveat.en: Not simulated: the soft tissue of the hand is thinner than a cage cell.

caveat.zh: 转述的数值，压头和载荷范围未知；足跟垫厚度与笼子单元同量级，没有模拟。
caveat.en: A quoted value with unknown indenter and load range; the heel pad is about one cage cell thick and was not simulated.

notFound.zh: 大腿、腹部、乳房、臀部的在体压入力–位移曲线：检索了 Europe PMC 的开放获取文献，没有找到可用的，所以这些部位只报告我们自己的数值，没有对照。腹部体位变化（站立与仰卧的腹部轮廓）的已发表数值同样没有找到。
notFound.en: In-vivo indentation force–displacement curves for thigh, abdomen, breast and buttock: Europe PMC open-access literature was searched and nothing usable found, so for those sites only our own numbers are reported, without a comparison. Published numbers for the abdominal profile standing versus supine were not found either.

what.zh: 乳房内标志点从俯卧到仰卧的位移（刚性对齐之后）
what.en: displacement of landmarks inside the breast from prone to supine (after rigid alignment)

posture.where: abstract: combined mean TRE before registration, all fourteen clinical data sets

use.zh: 只作方向和量级的对照。俯卧到仰卧重力反转（变化 2g）；站立到仰卧重力转 90°（变化 √2·g），按线性比例约为其 0.71 倍——这个换算是本项目的推算，不是该文的结果。
use.en: For direction and order of magnitude only. Prone to supine reverses gravity (a change of 2g); standing to supine turns it by 90° (a change of √2·g), about 0.71 of that by linear scaling: this conversion is this project's inference, not a result of the paper.

note.en: The paper's text says 547 and its figure caption 574.

muscle.where: results and discussion paragraphs; the example is Fig. 3 of the paper

forearm2026.citation: Development and Surface Indentation Assessment of an MRI-Based Subject-Specific Hand–Forearm Finite Element Model: A Preliminary Study. Bioengineering (Basel) 2026.
forearm2026.opened: full text (Europe PMC XML): abstract, section 2.3–2.5, Table 4 and the notes of Tables 7–9

note.zh: 单个健康成年男性受试者；作者自称初步研究。表 4 的本构参数是该文从别的文献里取的候选值，那些原始文献本项目没有打开。
note.en: One healthy adult male volunteer; called a preliminary study by its authors. The constitutive parameters of its Table 4 are candidates taken from other papers, which this project did not open.

proneSupine2016.citation: Eiben B et al. Symmetric Biomechanically Guided Prone-to-Supine Breast Image Registration. Ann Biomed Eng 2016.
proneSupine2016.opened: full text: abstract and the paragraph introducing Table 3

note.zh: 14 组临床影像（9 组俯卧 MRI–仰卧 CT、1 组 CT、4 组 MRI）；刚性对齐后的标志点距离即俯卧到仰卧的组织位移量级。受试者是乳腺癌患者，乳房体积没有在打开的段落里给出。
note.en: Fourteen clinical image pairs (nine prone MRI–supine CT, one CT, four MRI); the landmark distance after rigid alignment is the scale of tissue motion from prone to supine. The subjects are breast cancer patients; breast volume is not given in the passages opened.

vastus2014.citation: Shear Modulus Estimation on Vastus Intermedius of Elderly and Young Females over the Entire Range of Isometric Contraction. PLoS One 2014.
vastus2014.opened: full text: results and discussion paragraphs with the shear moduli

note.zh: 振动超声剪切波法，沿肌纤维方向的剪切模量；该文正文两处对老年组和青年组的放松值写法相反（9.5±3.3 与 12.8±5.4 kPa），这里只取范围。
note.en: Vibro-ultrasound shear waves, shear modulus along the fibres; the paper's text assigns the two relaxed values (9.5±3.3 and 12.8±5.4 kPa) to the elderly and the young group inconsistently in two places, so only the range is used here.

heelSex2020.citation: Sex differences in heel pad stiffness during in vivo loading and unloading. J Anat 2020.
heelSex2020.opened: full text: discussion sentence quoting Borros & Challis 2003

note.zh: 只取了它转述的一组数（足跟垫刚度），压头形状和载荷范围在打开的句子里没有给出。
note.en: Only one quoted pair of numbers (heel pad stiffness) was taken; indenter shape and load range are not given in the sentence opened.
